sonnet.problem: Card 6 just told 'commit your way to the LORD and trust in Him.' The True statement repeats that and adds only 'and He will do it.' It adds no new claim for the baker to reason out, so it is a recap of the card before.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: No card sets up verse 39, and the fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to complete the verse's exact wording ('their ___ in time of ___'). The baker cannot reason it out from anything shown earlier. It is a guess at the next words of a line.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
